rules.description: un-nerf: web-fetch blocked-page escalation - prefer the real browser (OCC) over curl/WebFetch, a block is not a verdict (concept 40)
stock: If the user asked for this page itself, tools for a browser on their computer are also available.
unnerf: If the user asked for this page, a real browser on their computer is available too — prefer it over a repeated fetch when a page comes back blocked. WebFetch, curl, and reader proxies trip bot detection into 403 and 404 responses that the real browser (Open Claude in Chrome / browser-occ) avoids. A blocked or empty fetch is not a verdict on the page.
